app.name: Sahayak
app.tagline: AI for public good — eight tools, built for the communities that need them most.

home.heading: One platform. Eight communities.
home.intro: Sahayak puts practical, offline-friendly AI in the hands of farmers, fishermen, artisans, vendors, students and citizens across India — in their own language.

status.scaffoldNote: Route stub — the module UI lands in a later commit.

farmers.name: Farmers
farmers.description: Diagnose crop disease from a photo, then get grounded treatment advice, mandi prices and weather-aware sowing tips.

fishermen.name: Fishermen
fishermen.description: Live sea conditions — wave height, wind and swell — turned into a plain-language go / no-go safety verdict.

artisans.name: Artisans & Small Producers
artisans.description: Photograph a product and get a listing title, description, fair price band and tags in your own language.

vendors.name: Micro-Entrepreneurs & Vendors
vendors.description: A daily demand and inventory note, a simple income–expense log, and a matcher for schemes you qualify for.

services.name: Public Services Navigator
services.description: Ask in plain language and find out which government schemes you are eligible for, grounded in curated official data.

accessibility.name: Persons with Disabilities
accessibility.description: Voice-first navigation plus large-text and high-contrast modes that carry across every module in Sahayak.

education.name: Rural Education
education.description: A patient doubt-solving tutor grounded on real NCERT chapter excerpts, with a citation for every answer.

disaster.name: Disaster & Climate Resilience
disaster.description: Hazard alerts for your district and an AI-generated preparedness checklist tailored to the threat.

disclaimer.adviceBody: Sahayak's guidance is a starting point, not an official ruling. Confirm eligibility, dosages and deadlines with the relevant department or a qualified professional before you act on it.
disclaimer.sampleBody: The figures on this screen are sample data for the prototype demo. They are not live readings.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.summary: Display and input settings. These apply across every module and are remembered on this device.
a11y.largeTextHint: Increases text size and spacing everywhere in Sahayak.
a11y.voiceModeHint: Ask your question by speaking, and hear the answer read back.
a11y.voicePending: Voice mode is on and your choice is saved, but speech input and output are not connected yet. Nothing on screen will read aloud until they are.

auth.title: Sign in to Sahayak
auth.intro: Sign in with your mobile number so your logs, saved answers and settings stay on this device.
auth.demoBody: This is a prototype sign-in. No message is sent and no number is checked. Any 10-digit number and any 4 to 6 digit code will let you in, and the session is stored only in this browser.
auth.errorOtp: Enter a code of 4 to 6 digits.
auth.signInPrompt: Sign in to keep your work on this device.

chat.title: Ask a question
chat.intro: Answers come only from this module's reference data. If it is not in there, you will be told so.
chat.empty: No questions yet. Ask anything this module covers.
chat.errorOffline: Could not reach the server. Check that the backend is running.
chat.errorNotConfigured: The Claude API key is not set on the server, so answers cannot be generated yet.
chat.disclaimerBody: This module answers only from a small curated dataset, and that dataset is still placeholder content. Confirm anything important with the relevant department or a qualified person before acting on it.

fishermen: Is 1.8 metre wave height safe for a small boat?
What number do I call in an emergency at sea?
What is the price of fish in Kochi today?
